name: Shreya Chandrakant Thakre
bio: Geoscientist with an MSc in Applied Geology from IIEST Shibpur. Worked in computational mineral physics and mineral anisotropy. Currently exploring the geophysics of the Indian crust using seismic ambient noise and InSAR.
work: I'm working on seismic ambient noise analysis to understand the geodynamic evolution of the Satpura Gondwana Basin and CITZ (Central Indian Tectonic Zone). I also have experience working with InSAR (Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar) and induced seismicity.

name: Subhkaran Mahla
bio: Former Junior Research Fellow at IISER Bhopal, conducted research in Environmental Seismology and Hydrometeorology
work: Research work in Environmental Seismology and Hydrometeorology, with experience in seismic, geospatial, and environmental data analysis and processing using GIS and Python.

name: Mitali Thakur
bio: I am Mitali Thakur, a BS-MS graduate in Earth and Environmental Sciences from IISER Bhopal. My research interests center on environmental seismology, ambient noise interferometry, and hydrological monitoring. I enjoy learning new analytical techniques to explore subsurface processes, and outside the lab, I spend my free time crocheting and cooking.
work: My research interests focus on investigating subsurface hydrological processes through ambient seismic noise interferometry and seismic velocity monitoring. My work involves the analysis of continuous seismic records, signal processing techniques, and the integration of hydrological observations to understand temporal variations in subsurface properties.
